title: Utility Commands (util time-ms, util uuid)
description: Implement the two utility commands: util time-ms outputs the current UTC time as a Unix millisecond timestamp, and util uuid generates a random UUID v4. These are stateless, have no dependencies on accounts or auth, and depend only on the output contract established in Story 2.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1 and 2 complete. IOutputWriter, ZapiCliException, GlobalSettings, and Program.cs CommandApp all exist. No account or auth infrastructure required.
goal: zapi-cli util time-ms outputs {"ts": <unix ms timestamp>} and zapi-cli util uuid outputs {"uuid": "<uuid v4>"} on stdout as plain JSON. Both commands exit 0.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/UtilCommands.cs with two command classes.
UtilTimeMsCommand extends AsyncCommand<UtilTimeMsSettings>: call DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(); WriteJson(new { ts = timestampMs }). Exit 0.
UtilUuidCommand extends AsyncCommand<UtilUuidSettings>: call Guid.NewGuid().ToString(); WriteJson(new { uuid = guidString }). Exit 0.
Register both commands under the 'util' branch in Program.cs CommandApp.

Unit tests: UtilTimeMsCommand returns a long > 0 in the ts field; the value is within 5 seconds of DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(); UtilUuidCommand returns a non-empty string in the uuid field that parses as a valid Guid.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
zapi-cli util time-ms outputs {"ts": <number>} on stdout, number is a positive long, exit 0
zapi-cli util uuid outputs {"uuid": "<xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx>"} on stdout, exit 0
Neither command touches accounts.json, keychain, or network
Both commands respect --no-input without any different behaviour (they are always non-interactive)
contextForAgent: These are simple utility commands with no domain logic. Use Guid.NewGuid().ToString() for UUID v4. Use DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds() for the Unix ms timestamp. Both output via IOutputWriter.WriteJson with anonymous objects — the snake_case serializer will correctly render 'ts' and 'uuid'. Register with the correct Spectre command tree: zapi-cli util time-ms and zapi-cli util uuid.
